## Professional Summary
Creative and detail-oriented Motion Designer focused on visual storytelling, dynamic typography and engaging video content. Skilled in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator and Photoshop to transform concepts into clean, modern motion graphics for digital and social media platforms.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. SaaS Product Walkthroughs: Interactive dashboard previews, feature walkthroughs and crisp interface motion designed for conversion.
2. Dynamic Kinetic Typography: Expressive editorial text animation and brand reveals choreographed with weighted keyframe velocity.
3. High-Retention Social Reels: Vertical 9:16 and 16:9 promotional hooks engineered for gaming creators, digital brands and viral feeds.
4. Vector Staging and Clean Handoff: Multi-layer asset prep in Illustrator and Photoshop exported to crisp ProRes/MP4 with organized .AEP source files.

## Production Suite
- Animation & Motion Engine: Adobe After Effects (Graph Editor, expressions, track mattes, shape morphs)
- Vector & Asset Design: Adobe Illustrator (vector paths, typography layout, color palettes)
- Matte & Color Treatment: Adobe Photoshop (texture synthesis, photo touch-ups, color balancing)
- Export Pipeline: Adobe Media Encoder (ProRes 422, H.264, WebM)
